item.title: Four cheetah cubs welcomed at San Diego Zoo Safari Park
item.description: The San Diego Zoo Safari Park welcomed four male cheetah cubs to the Ultimate Safari. The birth of the four cheetah cubs is the safari park's first one since 2020.

item.title: ABC7, USC to host California gubernatorial debate on March 24
item.description: ABC7 and the USC Dornsife Center for the Political Future will host a gubernatorial debate on Tuesday, March 24, with Univision 34/KMEX Los Angeles serving as the official Spanish-language broadcaster.

item.title: No love lost between top Republicans in CA governor's race Steve Hilton and Chad Bianco
item.description: Polling in the California governor's race has former Fox News host Steve Hilton and Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco not only in the top tier but leading the pack in some surveys.

item.title: 2 dead after stabbing attack in downtown Riverside, authorities say
item.description: Two people were found dead Thursday morning after a stabbing attack in downtown Riverside, authorities said.

item.title: With gangs behind many SoCal break-ins, experts explain how to protect your home
item.description: Over the past few months, we've covered a string of home break-ins in the San Fernando Valley and beyond. So who's behind the crime, how do you best protect your home, and are break-ins actually surging?

item.title: Trump administration sues California over state's nation-leading vehicle-emission rules
item.description: The Trump administration ramped up a battle with California over the state's nation-leading vehicle-emission standards Thursday, suing air regulators over rules aimed at curbing pollution from cars.

item.title: Record heat possible Friday as SoCal braces for hotter temps next week
item.description: Friday could bring more record-breaking heat to Southern California, and it's expected to be even hotter next week.

item.title: $6 million in Birkin bags, Rolexes, guns and cash found during Temecula burglary arrest
item.description: A man wanted in connection with a January burglary was arrested this week, leading to the discovery of more than $6 million in stolen luxury items at his home in Temecula, police said.

item.title: Iconic Newport Beach movie theater to be replaced by high-rise condos
item.description: Regal Edwards Big Newport, which opened in 1969, is going to be replaced by two 22-story residential condominium towers, reshaping the fabric around Fashion Island.

item.title: Suspect steals $20,000 worth of camera gear from Riverside business
item.description: Thousands of dollars' worth of equipment was stolen from a business in Riverside - and it was all caught on video.
